newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan 1997 Jan-March GDP likely around June 13-EPA.
newsitem.headline: Japan 1997 Jan-March GDP likely around June 13-EPA.

text.p: The government is likely to announce Japan's gross domestic product (GDP) data for the January-March quarter around June 13, Economic Planning Agency (EPA) Vice Minister Shimpei Nukaya told a news conference on Friday.
Nukaya said that while the EPA had announced January-March GDP data on June 19 last year, he would like to see it released much earlier this year.
"The October-December data was announced on March 13 so the January-March data is mostly likely to be announced around June 13," he said.
